page.overview:
What is Twisted Bonnie?

is one of the four twisted animatronics and an antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Twisted Ones. He is the twisted incarnation of Bonnie, which was created by William Afton to hunt down and kill Charlotte Emily.

Twisted Bonnie is an eight-foot tall misshapen Bonnie. His head is too large for his body, with glowing white-hot eyes. Twisted Bonnie’s mouth has several rows of gleaming teeth. Its normal form without his illusion disc is never described other than being made of plastic.

In the official teasers, Twisted Bonnie is a large, blue-purple animatronic rabbit with an organic-looking body. He sports articulated ears, each split into three segments. His suit is badly damaged, including a massive hole on his chest that exposes his endoskeleton. He also has boils on his arms and legs, spikes protruding from his upper arms, wiry whiskers similar to Nightmare Bonnie, and an additional bottom jaw that is separated into two protrusions sticking out of the bottom of his head. On his hands are hook-like black claws.

Twisted Bonnie, along with Twisted Wolf, first appear in Chapter 13 at the underground pizzeria. The two of them are surrounding Charlie, John, Jessica, and Clay Burke from escaping. William appears and introduces himself as Springtrap, and instructs that he needs something from Charlie, and they'll leave the group unharmed, however the four of them manage to escape, and William orders the animatronics to get them.
